# SveltyCMS

> SveltyCMS is a self-hosted CMS. Editors use the admin. Other applications call REST or GraphQL. Server code inside this project calls LocalCMS. Collections run on SQLite, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, or MongoDB. The stack is SvelteKit 3 (RC), Svelte 5, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.

The public docs are organized by the question the reader has. Architecture essays, test write-ups, and project records are linked from these sections. They are not the first page a new editor should open.

## Get started

- [Getting started](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/getting-started): Install, run the setup wizard, create a collection.
- [Onboarding](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/onboarding): Tutorials after install.
- [Setup walkthrough](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/onboarding/setup-wizard): The short first run after install.
- [Persona paths](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/onboarding/persona-paths): Next reading for editors, administrators, and developers.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/troubleshooting): Common failures.

## Concepts

- [Concepts](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/concepts): Collection, entry, widget, tenant, the three APIs, and the database adapter.

## Guides

Task recipes for the admin and for operations.

- [Guides](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides): Index.
- [Collection Builder](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/collection-builder): Collections, fields, and relations.
- [Workflows](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/workflows): Draft, review, and publish.
- [Automations](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/automations): Emails, webhooks, and field updates when an entry changes.
- [E-commerce](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/ecommerce): Optional catalog, orders, and payments.
- [Maintenance](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/maintenance): Watchdog, cache compaction, and trash purge.
- [Image editor](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/image-editor): Crop and edit media.
- [Migration and import](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/migration-and-import): Bring content in from a file or another CMS.
- [Access management](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/access-management): Roles and permissions.
- [System settings](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/system-settings): Site, cache, and security settings.
- [System languages](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/system-languages): Admin locales.
- [Email](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/email-system): SMTP and templates.
- [Upgrading](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/upgrading): Move an existing install forward.
- [Production deployment](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/deployment/production-deployment): Run for real traffic.
- [GDPR](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/legal/gdpr-compliance): Privacy obligations for an install.

## Build

Extend the CMS.

- [Development](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development): Index.
- [Widgets](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/widgets): Custom fields. Definition, input, and display.
- [Dashboard widgets](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/dashboard): Cards on the admin dashboard.
- [Local SDK vs HTTP](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/local-vs-http-api): When server code should call LocalCMS.
- [Site starter](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/site-starter): Optional public site in this repo.
- [Plugins](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/plugins/development): Server hooks. The runtime (boot, capabilities, encrypted settings) is [Plugin runtime](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/architecture/plugin-architecture).

## Reference

Look up a contract.

- [Reference](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference): Index.
- [API](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/api): REST, GraphQL, and related endpoints.
- [Security](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/security): Auth, CSP, field access, incident response.
- [Database](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/database): SQLite, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and MongoDB adapters.
- [Components](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/components): Admin collection UI.
- [Architecture](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/architecture): Why the engine is built this way. Read the page for the subsystem you are changing.

## Contribute

- [Contributing to the documentation](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/contributing/contributing-docs): Where a page belongs, style, and the pull request.
- [Admin style guide](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/contributing/style-guide-gui): Admin UI patterns.
- [Accessibility](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/contributing/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 AA and ATAG 2.0.
- [Validation pipeline](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/contributing/validation-pipeline): Git hooks and CI.

## Machine-readable extras

- [OpenAPI](https://demo.sveltycms.com/api/openapi.json): Generated from the running CMS.
- [MCP knowledge server](https://mcp.sveltycms.com/mcp): Live tools over the project knowledge base.
- [Source](https://github.com/SveltyCMS/SveltyCMS): The product repository. These docs live in `docs/`.
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.sveltycms.com): Widgets, plugins, and themes.
